overrides.purpose: Minimal context-organization successor to V25. V26 changes only the reflection evidence representation and partitions the former whole-run reflection into three lossless domain evidence calls. Each combat is presented as one initial state plus ordered actions and resulting states; complete card definitions are stored once and deck order, duplicate counts, upgrades, and instance overrides use exact references; repeated memory/version exposure groups are stored once instead of being copied for every decision. Every representation is expanded before use in the acceptance audit and must round-trip exactly to the original evidence. Baseline prompts, complete decision-time context, legal actions, CoT routing, memory semantics, retrieval, injection, checkpoint timing, and lifecycle rules are unchanged. V25 remains an immutable paused pre-acceptance artifact.

memory.run_end_context_partition_contract: The one logical complete-run checkpoint is represented by three sequential model calls over complete combat, card-choice, and route evidence respectively. Cross-domain hypotheses remain allowed when grounded in the supplied slice. This changes context packaging, not environment decisions or checkpoint timing.
memory.reflection_evidence_contract: Model-facing reflection evidence is organized by checkpoint-level events rather than repeated decision snapshots. Combat, deck, and exposure representations must satisfy expand(compact(source)) == source before any provider request. No trajectory action, model reason, engine change, state fact, card effect, upgrade, deck duplicate/order, exposure, or memory version may be omitted.
memory.reflection_evidence_audit_contract: Every reflection_request records the representation versions, normalized model-evidence SHA256, and exactly expanded source-evidence SHA256. Acceptance expands the model-facing evidence before comparing it with the full trace.
